met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure area over northern parts of central Uttar Pradesh persisted over the same region at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 27th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level. It is very likely to move north-northwestwards across Uttar Pradesh and weaken gradually into a Low Pressure Area during next 12 hours.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & Upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 24°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The low pressure area over south coastal Myanmar & neighbourhood persisted over the same region at 0830 hrs IST of today, the 27th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 9.4 km above mean sea level. It is likely to emerge into north Andaman Sea and adjoining Irrawaddy delta of Myanmar during next 24 hours and move north-northwestwards along and off Myanmar–Bangladesh coasts towards northeast Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh during subsequent 2 days.
The north-south trough now runs from Bihar to Westcentral Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand, Odisha and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
